thread:
Ravi Gupta: Noticed overall p99 for /v1/generate spiked from 220ms -> 1.1s after I toggled the dashboard merge setting. No service deploy.
Elena Morales: Can you paste backend tdigest numbers? UI might be re-binning.
Ravi Gupta: Backend (15m): samples=260, p50=60ms, p95=200ms, p99=230ms. UI (merged buckets) shows p99=1.1s.
Chris Yang: Sounds like client-side bucket merge is overcounting sparse high bins. We historically used server-merged tdigest for alerts. Did alerting use UI value?
Ravi Gupta: Yes, alert fired based on the displayed value. False alarm.
deploy-bot: feature:dashboard_bucket_merge toggled=true rollout/2024-02-11-09
Elena Morales: Short term: disable bucket-merge for numeric panels and add a "low-sample" hint when sample_count < 100. Long term: change UI to fetch server-merged tdigest for percentiles.
Chris Yang: I'll open ENGPLAT-4021 with repro + patch to ensure alerts read telemetry.aggregate=server.
Ravi Gupta: Thanks — would be great to auto-detect when UI-derived pctl deviates >20% from server pctl and surface a warning.
Elena Morales: agreed. Adding that to the ticket.
